info.description:
Receive-and-store mail platform for ProductCraft

## Rate limits

Every `/v1` route is limited per client IP to 20 requests per second and 600 per minute. Each response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit-short`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-short`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-short` (the one-second window) and the same three with `-long` (the one-minute window). Over either limit the response is `429` with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

Sending is also limited per workspace: 60 emails per minute, 600 per hour and 10,000 per day (test sends: 30 per hour, counted separately). A send over a workspace limit is `429` `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`, `ratelimit-limit`, `ratelimit-remaining` and `ratelimit-reset` for the window that tripped, and `details: { window, limit, retry_after }`. In a batch send, a row over the limit is rejected with `RATE_LIMITED` and the other rows are unaffected.

Some routes have their own, tighter limits (domain lookups, DNS checks, exports, share links); each says so in its `429` response.
